long_biography.plain_text:
Supreme Group became an international supply network for food, water and fuel under Stephen Orenstein. His father, Alfred, had founded it to provision American military bases in Germany. When Alfred died in 1985, Orenstein took over and expanded the family business into demanding markets; supplying American forces in Afghanistan became its defining assignment.

Orenstein is no longer Supreme's majority owner. He also invested in Eintracht Frankfurt, where he had held a season ticket from the same year, and served on the football company's supervisory board before stepping down in 2024. He now chairs the supervisory board at CRX Markets, a working-capital finance platform.
